Subsequent heat treatment at 200 /C176C for 1 hour resulted in a tensile yield strength of 275 MPa, an ultimate tensile strength of 316 MPa, an elongation of 16.7%, and a thermal conductivity of 128.6 W/(m ÆK).

The as-cast Mg 97Zn2Gd0.5Y0.5 alloy was prepared by anti-gravity casting in CO 2/SF6 protective atmosphere. Pure Mg (99.9%), pure Zn (99.9%), Mg-30Gd (wt.%), and Mg-30Y (wt.%) were added sequentially to the crucible in a resistance furnace at 760 /C176C. After the melting, stirring, and standing, the melt was poured into a steel mold (preheated to 300 /C176C).
The samples were homogenized at 500 /C176C for 12 h, followed by water quenching.

parameters.deformation: total reduction 87.5% (8 mm to 1 mm) by nine passes; reductions: six passes ~10%, then 20% and 37.5%, final pass 50%; reheated to 450 °C for 10 min between passes; preheated 450 °C 30 min

evidence.quote: The samples were heated to 450 /C176C in a resistance furnace for multi-pass rolling. The hot-rolled sheets after each pass were reheated to 450 /C176C and held for 10 min to ensure the rolling temperature consistency, and the sheets cooled in the water after the final rolling pass. Before rolling, the sheets were preheated at 450 /C176C for 30 min. In the pre-rolling stage, the low-strain rolling was introduced with thickness reductions of approximately 10%. The sheets were rolled from 8 to 4 mm in thickness with the total reduction of 50% by six passes. Then, the medium-strain rolling was applied in the second stage. The sheets were rolled to 2 mm after one pass 20% and 37.5% thickness reductions. Finally, the 2-mm-thick sheets were rolled with a large final rolling reduction of 50% which resulted in a total reduction of 87.5% with sheets thickness of 1 mm.
Heat treatment was carried out with as-rolled samples at 200 /C176C, followed by water quenching.
